content:
Early in my career, I used to treat professional setbacks as pure interruptions.

I wanted smooth sailing, predictable metrics, and zero friction.

But looking back, every major breakthrough whether in content, client strategy, or personal growth was preceded by a period of chaos.

The storm forces you to:
Strip away what isn't working.
Build stronger systems.
Gain clarity on your real priorities.

If you're navigating a tough season right now: keep going. It’s refining you, not defining you.
comment: A useful distinction is that not every setback needs a comeback story. Sometimes the real value is learning which systems, habits, or assumptions should be retired before rebuilding.
